entities.summary:
RCA Records is an American record label founded in 1901 within the Radio Corporation of America’s music businesses and long headquartered in New York City. It became one of the major labels that shaped recorded sound from Victor Talking Machine roots through mid-century popular, classical, and later rock catalogues.

Artists from Caruso-era prestige to Elvis Presley made RCA a cultural power broker in the American Century’s music industry, later folding into larger conglomerates while retaining the brand. Studio technology and national distribution defined its industrial edge.

RCA Records charts how corporate electronics firms industrialised popular music.
